verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs explicitly describe 'Sprites' and Fly Machines as hardware-isolated VMs with a clean baseline per request, egress-locked and disposable — directly matching the story of running untrusted code in disposable, hardware-isolated sandboxes (fly-io-docs-7, fly-io-docs-14, fly-io-docs-6). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the isolation guarantees and disposability claims (only first-party marketing copy is available), and community evidence focuses on general platform reliability rather than sandbox security specifically.
